brief:
Mike Huckabee refused to condemn Israeli terrorism during an appearance on Tucker Carlson Network. The former Arkansas governor and Republican political figure did not offer criticism when directly presented with the question, according to the outlet's reporting of the segment.

The exchange took place during a broadcast discussion but Huckabee provided no statement rejecting accusations of terrorism against Israeli forces or officials. His silence on the matter drew attention from the network's coverage, which documented his response to the specific line of questioning without elaboration on his reasoning or position.
title: Huckabee declines to condemn Israeli terrorism, Tucker Carlson Network reports
